dedupe_keys.name: aqua monitor surface water change pipeline

description: Aqua Monitor is Deltares' software for mapping surface-water change from satellite observations. It serves a static map for 1985–2016 and supports dynamic comparison of selected years using Google Earth Engine, with percentile composites and configurable change filters. The repository documents JavaScript/Python web deployment and links the processing scripts. Coverage is global, while temporal windows, filtering and mapped detail vary with the requested analysis. Public source is free under LGPL-3.0; deployment requires separately configured Google services and access. A limitation is that the static-map workflow omits some cleanup applied to results in the describing paper. Experimental high-detail options can be slow or fail, and vegetation changes can affect classification. The pipeline can prepare changing-water-boundary evidence for flood, reservoir or coastal infrastructure studies, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The Nature Climate Change article documents the method. A similarly named rejected NIVA Aquamonitor candidate is a different resource. No satellite imagery or credentials were accessed.
name: Aqua Monitor surface-water change pipeline
